items.name: event-utils
items.description: Event dedupe, payload parsing, the chat-message reducer, and the agent-activity timeline (ACP + flat event dialects).

items.name: reflex-provider
items.description: React context provider: configures the SDK, owns the socket and a QueryClient.

items.name: use-agent-stream
items.description: React Query hook for an agent's event stream with live WebSocket cache updates.

items.name: use-send-message
items.description: Send-message mutation with an optimistic pending bubble; sends attachments as image/file content blocks.

items.name: use-interrupt-agent
items.description: Interrupt mutation: stop the agent's current turn.

items.name: markdown-content
items.description: Standalone GFM markdown renderer with chat styling: inline-code chips, fenced blocks, lists, tables.

items.name: tool-call-line
items.description: Tool invocations as compact mono lines, plus ToolCallGroup: a run of calls collapsed behind an 'N more' expander.

items.name: thought-block
items.description: A thinking section collapsed behind a disclosure.

items.name: system-note
items.description: A centered, muted lifecycle note between messages.

items.name: message-bubble
items.description: One chat message: markdown agent blocks (via markdown-content) and accent user bubbles, themeable via --reflex-chat-* CSS variables.

items.name: message-list
items.description: Scrolling transcript composing the primitives over the agent-activity timeline: bubbles, collapsed thoughts, grouped tool runs, lifecycle notes, pin-aware autoscroll, renderItem overrides.

items.name: chat-composer
items.description: Composer bar: auto-growing textarea, attachments (picker, drag & drop, paste), voice dictation, interrupt and send buttons.

items.name: chat-pane
items.description: Complete agent chat pane: header with live status, activity transcript, composer (or read-only footer).

items.name: agent-chat
items.description: The drop-in: provider + full chat pane as one component (baseUrl, apiKey, agentId).

items.name: chat
items.description: Everything: provider, hooks, and the full chat pane.
